### How to Honor the Sabbath
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-15-2017.html
Passage: Mark 2:27
Points:
- Legalistic rules and busyness distort the original purpose of Sabbath rest.
- God designed human beings with an intrinsic need for regular physical and spiritual renewal.
- Stepping away from work and devices demonstrates active trust in God to provide.
- The Sabbath is meant to be received as a gift rather than an onerous duty to perform perfectly.

### Lord of the Sabbath
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-sabbath
Passage: Mark 2:28
Points:
- The Pharisees distorted God's law by turning a day of rest into an oppressive checklist of prohibitions.
- The Sabbath was designed to refresh humanity rather than serve as a heavy burden.
- By identifying Himself as the Lord of the Sabbath, Jesus asserted His divine authority and deity.
- As the author and fulfiller of the law, Jesus provides the true standard for interpreting and living God's Word.
